In the heart of Uttarakhand’s serene hills, where nature hums with ancient wisdom, I have created my sanctuary, Soul Storries. As the CEO and Owner, my journey to this haven began in a time of stillness brought by Covid. As a vibrant traveler, my spirit chafed against the confines of my home. Yet, it was during this time of solitude that my heart ached for the expansive embrace of my homeland.

When I finally revisited Uttarakhand, a profound awakening stirred within me. Surrounded by lush valleys and tranquil mountains, I felt a deep connection to my inner consciousness, a yearning for meaning beyond the everyday. I discovered a harmonious existence, one that blends serenity with the enigmatic beauty of nature, offering a wellspring of renewed energy, profound thoughts, and a vision that extends beyond mere self-interest.

Rooted in my heritage, I found comfort and meaning among the native people, their traditions, and the simple yet rich flavors of our local cuisine. This revelation inspired me to create Soul Storries – a place for others to experience this deep, soulful connection.

Soul Storries is an embodiment of my vision: a luxurious villa that is a slice of heaven on Earth, secluded from the mechanical bustle yet deeply connected to nature. Every aspect of this villa has been lovingly crafted, resonating with the spirit of the natural world. Its construction, a sustainable wooden lego-based modular model, was designed to coexist gently with our environment, using materials brought from Finland and incorporating an advanced DGU system by Saint Gobain. Every room in Soul Storries has its own tale, each corner offering a glimpse of the heavenly landscape that cradles us.
We're Proud to Create Delicious Dishes & Deserts

The essence of Soul Storries extends to the food we serve – local, farm-fresh produce, prepared by hands that know the land, combining the skill of a Michelin-starred chef with the authenticity of our native cuisine.

Here, nature orchestrates a symphony of the elements – the whispering wind, the pristine snow, and the playful sunlight. The days here are a canvas of contrasts: radiant mornings, drizzling noons, cool evenings, and crisp nights. Soul Storries is more than a destination; it is a journey to the core of one’s being, a place where every moment is a chance for introspection and connection with the essence of life.

In this place, I, Madhavi Madaan, invite you to partake in an experience that transcends the conventional notions of luxury or relaxation. It is an invitation to rediscover yourself amidst the untouched beauty of nature. Welcome to Soul Storries – where each moment is a step closer to your true self, a story waiting to be lived.

There are moments in life when your body whispers for rest and your mind longs for stillness. A retreat in the Himalayas is not just a holiday, it’s an inner reset. Here at Soul Storries, nestled in the Mussoorie hills, we have seen how a few days away from the noise can transform the way you feel, think, and even breathe.

Unlike ordinary vacations, a Himalayan retreat allows you to step into silence. The crisp mountain air, the sound of rustling pines, and the sight of endless valleys, it all works like therapy. Guests often tell us how quickly stress melts away, replaced by a sense of deep calm. This is the hidden charm of the Himalayan wellness retreat benefits : your soul finds space to recharge.

Every stay here is designed with intention. From organic meals prepared with local ingredients to guided yoga and meditation, every detail supports your journey back to balance. Choosing a Soul Storries Mussoorie stay means surrounding yourself with nature’s energy, while enjoying the quiet luxury of comfort.
